verdict.rationale: USCIS is an online service that collects and holds personal data, so whether users can keep that data out of AI training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack documents no AI-training opt-out or any statement on AI training use. The FOIA/Privacy Act request API covers record access, a different capability, and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
